elements.label: App content area: nav menu and P&L sheet clearing to a blank loading page with spinner

pattern.description: A recorded navigation in two steps. The blue left nav menu collapses and the sheet briefly shows a highlighted accounts column (first energy spike). Then the whole content area clears to a blank page with a centred loading spinner (second spike), while the window chrome and logo stay in place.
pattern.why_premium: Not authored motion. It is a raw app page transition left in the edit, and the narration ('key financial statements and metrics') bridges it. The steady window frame keeps it from feeling like a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(navMenu, {xPercent: -100, duration: 0.05, ease: 'none'}).set(sheet, {autoAlpha: 0}, '+=0.3').set(spinner, {autoAlpha: 1}, '<'); in a recreation, prefer replacing the spinner with a short blur_crossfade to the next sheet.
build_hint.remotion: Sequence the nav-open frame, then the sheet frame, then at f0 switch to the blank/spinner layer (opacity steps, no interpolation); a recreation would better use a 200-300 ms crossfade straight to the destination screen.

notes: There are two separate energy spikes (frames ~3111 and ~3119), and b01 covers both. The nav menu collapse could be split out as its own element, but it has no separate candidate box. No canonical pattern fits a reload-to-spinner, hence 'other'.
